Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football Betway launches GHS1m Level Up promotion with 2026 Jetour Dashing as grand prize Source : Joy Sports 20 November 2026 9:14am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Betway Ghana has launched a six-week promotion, Level Up, offering players a prize pool worth more than GHS1 million, including a brand-new 2026 Jetour Dashing as the grand prize.
Running from November 17 to December 27, 2026, the campaign covers sports betting, slots and crash games, with players competing for weekly rewards and places in the final prize draws.
Weekly prizes include cash rewards, free bets, free spins and free flights. The top 10 performers on each weekly leaderboard will also qualify for the final draws, where major prizes, including iPhone 18s and the 2026 Jetour Dashing, will be awarded.
Speaking at the launch, Betway Ghana Country Manager Jolade Adeoye said the promotion reflects the company's commitment to rewarding players and improving their gaming experience.
"Level Up is all about rewarding our players with one of our biggest year-end promotions," said Jolade.
"From weekly cash prizes and free bets to the chance to drive away in a brand-new 2026 Jetour Dashing, we're giving players more ways to win while enjoying the games they love. We've also designed the promotion to be simple and accessible, making it easy for players to participate and track their progress throughout the campaign."
Adeoye also emphasised the importance of responsible gambling as Betway marks Responsible Gambling Month in November.
"We encourage all players to stay in control of their spending and use the responsible gambling tools available on our platform. Responsible gambling remains a key part of our commitment to providing a safe and enjoyable betting experience for all our players," she added.
The promotion ends on December 27, with the final prize draw and grand prize handover scheduled for December 31, 2026.
With more than GHS1 million in prizes at stake, Betway's Level Up campaign is set to offer players across Ghana several opportunities to win as the year draws to a close.
